description: Service reliability data: latency, error rate, capacity, dependencies, incidents. Diurnal load curves, regression spikes, cascading failures.

characteristic_patterns.name: Diurnal load curve
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: FFT dominant frequency near 1/86400 Hz on rps

characteristic_patterns.name: Traffic spike
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: anomaly score on rps with severity ≥ warn

characteristic_patterns.name: Capacity saturation
characteristic_patterns.signature: p99 latency hockey-sticks while CPU/mem near 100%
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: saturation fit on (cpu, p99) succeeds with K small

characteristic_patterns.name: Deployment regression
characteristic_patterns.signature: step change in error_rate / latency aligned with deploy ts

characteristic_patterns.name: Cascading failure
characteristic_patterns.signature: dependency error spike → service error spike with lag

action_library.label: Scale up capacity
action_library.description: Add replicas / vertical resources before saturation triggers SLO breach.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Pre-emptive scale-up averts ≈80% of imminent breaches when triggered ≥ 5 min before saturation.

action_library.label: Roll back recent deployment
action_library.description: If a deployment-regression pattern is detected and confidence is high, revert to the prior known-good version.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Rollbacks resolve ≈70% of post-deploy regressions within 5 min.

action_library.label: Throttle / shed load
action_library.description: Apply rate limits at the edge to keep the SLO intact during a spike.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Throttling stabilises latency at the cost of some user-visible 429s.

action_library.label: Open dependency circuit breaker
action_library.description: When upstream is the bottleneck, fail fast rather than block on calls.
